newsitem.title: CHINA: HSBC HK bond index rose 0.92 pct to 127.48 in July.
newsitem.headline: HSBC HK bond index rose 0.92 pct to 127.48 in July.

text.p: HSBC Markets said its Hong Kong bond index rose to 127.48 in July 1997, a 0.92 percent increase from June 1997.
Both the sub-index for Hong Kong government paper and the sub-index for non-Hong Kong government paper rose by 0.92 percent.

Compared with levels at end-July 1996, the overall index increased by 10.4 percent, the sub-index for Hong Kong government paper rose by 9.5 percent and the sub-index for non-Hong Kong government paper increased by 10.9 percent.
